text: Sorry if this is a silly one. I'm a childminder and I've got a 2 year old girl overnight as her parents are stuck away. Temp was 37.6 about half an hour ago. She had calpol earlier and in between doses she's been fine, playing with her blocks, drinking her milk and chattering away. She hasn't done a poo for three days now and she's grumpy about it, keeps saying her tummy's cross. Right now she's flopped on the sofa because it's been a long day for her, but when I said her name she woke straight up and told me all about her teddy, completely herself. Probably nothing, it's mainly the not pooing I wanted to ask about
